articles.title: Italy: The rise of the student and youth movement in Europe
articles.author: Communist Workers’ Party, Italy
articles.content_excerpt: T he massive student movement in France—the largest since May 1968— the demonstrations in the streets of Spain demanding the right to housing, the beginning of its potential spread to Portugal, and the prolonged popular uprising in Albania with the explicit demand for the ouster of the Rama government, are ushering in a new chapter in Europe. We are witnessing the rise of the student and youth movement, which has the potential to spread. We cannot predict its future today, but it is essential to understand its characteristics. Palestine led the way Over the past two years, the pro-Palestinian movement has also seen a broad segment of the younger generation in Europe come to the forefront.
